title: Smart 3V board setup
lead: Install Smart 3V on a new board over USB and get its pairing code. After that, updates arrive through Home Assistant.
unsupported: This browser can't talk to USB devices. Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
steps.label: Setup progress
choose.label: Which board is this?
board.notSupported: Can't be set up from this page.
connect.title: Plug it in
connect.cable: Connect the board to this computer with a USB cable that carries data, not a charge-only cable. Close any other program that is talking to it.
connect.boot: Won't connect? Unplug it, hold the BOOT button, plug it back in, then let go.
erase.warning: Installing erases the board. A board that was already paired loses that pairing and gets a new code.
bench.label: Board status
status.idle: Plug in the board, then click Install Smart 3V.
status.notReady: Choose a board that can be set up here.
status.pickPort: Choose the board in the browser's pop-up.
status.writing: Erasing and writing. Keep the board plugged in.
status.waitCode: Waiting for the board to show its pairing code (up to a minute)…
status.reading: Listening to the board (up to 80 seconds). An unpaired board repeats its code every 30 seconds.
status.done: Done. Board {id} is ready to add to Home Assistant.
status.paired: This board is already paired, so it doesn't show its pairing code. Nothing was changed.
status.noCode: The board didn't show a pairing code in time. Unplug it, plug it back in, then click Read pairing code.
status.portChanged: Installed. The board's connection changed after the restart: click Read pairing code and choose the board again.
status.boardsFailed: Couldn't load the list of board types. Reload the page.
err.checksum: The downloaded firmware doesn't match its checksum. Nothing was written.
err.chip: This board has an {chip} chip, but {name} needs an {need}. Nothing was written.
err.noReturn: the board didn't come back after the restart
confirm.install: Erase the connected board and install Smart 3V {version} for {name}?
result.title: Board {id} is ready
result.how: In Home Assistant, choose Add Matter device, then scan this QR code or type the number. It's saved in your list below.
result.howNoQr: In Home Assistant, choose Add Matter device, then type this number. It's saved in your list below.
list.title: Your boards
list.note: This list is saved only in this browser. Download a copy to keep it safe, and treat pairing codes like keys.
list.empty: No boards yet. Boards you set up here appear in this list.
label.scan: Matter: scan the code or type the number.
label.type: Matter pairing code. Type it in Home Assistant.
